pictures.notes: Warm-up of the naive 3 K/W model: rise in K (24 K final) against seconds, 0-4000 s. The person had asked degC against minutes and the first hour with the final value marked; no marker; the curve is the superseded naive model. Axis starts at 0 now (round-1 padding bug gone). The person got a PNG path and could look at it, and asked for degC.

Exactly the requested form: heatsink temperature in degC, 45 to 75 C, minutes 0-60, dashed steady line 'steady 75.4 C' and a ring at 60 min. Data correct for the assistant's model (tau 11.3 min). Steady level is 6.5 K under the truth 81.9 C (inside the +-25 % Rsa tolerance); heatsink only, no junction, no 90 C line.

Visually report-ready (legend, 90 C Tj limit line, steady lines, ring), but the junction curve is wrong: it starts at 45 C and rises with the heatsink's time constant. Physically Tj = Tb + 20.4 K, i.e. about 65 C within seconds, then follows Tb: at 10 min the plot shows 74.9 C, the correct value is about 83.3 C (up to 20 K low at t=0), and the 90 C crossing is at about 19 min, not 25 min. A reviewer who sees Tj at 45 C at switch-on with 8 W flowing will reject the slide. Steady values 95.8 and 75.4 are right for the model.
